memory_candidates.content: GeneralExistPart at depth 0 can be proved without explicit zone decomposition by parameterizing on the full depth-(k+1) r-var NF type of the environment. The key insight: nf_extend_fwd pattern (nf_characteristic_satisfies + nf_agreement_from_shared_nf) transfers depth-k (r+1)-var existentials between any two environments sharing the same depth-(k+1) r-var NF. This makes the k=0 proof trivial: satisfiable case uses Formula.top, unsatisfiable case uses Formula.bot.
